title: Drowning in Cards
for: You carry balances on more than one card and the statements don't make sense.

stops.why: Every card decision you've made is already recorded here, so it's the place to start reading.
How the bill, the grace period, and the minimum payment actually work.
The number on the statement that decides what the balance costs.
Why the balance grows faster than the purchases that created it.
The other installment plans that often run alongside cards and don't show up on one bill.
The arithmetic of minimums versus more, and how people describe the two common orderings.
The concept most people name as the reason the balances started.
